text:
62세 여성, severe asthma exacerbation으로 acute respiratory distress 입원.  
BP 130/85 mmHg, HR 110 bpm, RR 28 breaths/min, BT 37.3°C, SpO2 89% (room air).  
Shortness of breath severe로 호소함.  
Albuterol 2.5 mg IV PRN 적용함.  
High-flow nasal cannula 산소공급 유지함.  
Ventilator 사용 중.  
Positive fluid balance 확인됨.  
Patient alert 상태 유지함.  
Respiratory therapist notify함.
